name: Jole Sanchez
quote: Jaimie approached me during our crowdfunding campaign for our short film, she was passionate about working on a project with AAPI artists and that was a big factor for me. I visited her website and her music samples were brilliant--I knew she was the composer I wanted to score my film. She created something special and listened to the ideas I had while challenging herself and trying different sounds to capture certain tones, and together we shaped something amazing for this project! Hopefully we'll get to work on something else in the near future!

name: Jiwon Lee
quote: Jaimie was the best composer I could ask for! From specific requests to the bits I did not have the answers to myself, Jaimie took what felt like ambiguous, impossible tasks in my head into the most beautiful scores that greatly elevated my film. One of the best creative decisions I've made as a director was to work with Jaimie. Simply communicating with her about your ideas alone will be an educational experience of its own.

name: Valerie Tan
quote: I worked with Jaime on GEM. The initial score was not working and I was having a tough time finding someone that could understand what I was trying to go for. Jaimie immediately got the child-like wonder that I was attempting to convey through the music and delivered a score that felt really grounded in a sci-fi short. Jaimie is really great at communication and getting to the heart of the music that a film needs. She took my idea and brought it somewhere beyond what I was expecting.

name: Nicole Dizon
quote: Jaimie did fantastic work on my magical realism/thriller short, "Morena!" I appreciated her openness to working with a local dance company to source regional instruments to add another layer of authenticity to my film. She understood my sensibilities and exceeded my expectations in adding a unique, irreplicable score to my film. I love that she was so patient and committed to pushing through new challenges that emerged throughout post. Can't recommend Jaimie highly enough!
